title: Province of Ontario - Provincial and territorial programs (Child and family benefits)
author: Canada Revenue Agency, Government of Canada
role: Official federal administrative publication (the CRA administers the Ontario benefits under the collection agreement) that states the July 2026 to June 2027 amounts indexed under s 23 (3.3) and (3.5) of the Taxation Act, 2007: the Ontario child benefit (up to $146.66 a month a child; partial above adjusted family net income of $26,865) and the Ontario sales tax credit ($378 for each adult and child; 4% reduction above $29,047 single or $36,309 family). Not an Ontario instrument; it is brought in for the indexed numbers only.
converter: The page's <main> element converted to plain text by a short Python script (scratchpad mk_deposit.py): scripts, styles and navigation dropped; HTML entities decoded; a three-line attribution and not-an-official-version header added. Nothing else altered.
